quests.title: Yachimatahime's Trial

dialogue.t: I am Eki of the Jibashiri. Hero of Sangonomiya, I acknowledge that you are worthy to take on this challenge.
I am in charge of the trial of "insight." Go forth and solve all the puzzles to return the Flames of the High Gate to their respective places.
The battlefield is ever-changing. Only by keeping your eyes and ears wide open at all times may you grasp the situation and master all these variables.
I am Eki of the Jibashiri. If you are here on unimportant affairs, depart from this place.
Have you completed the challenge, hero of Sangonomiya?
Use your insight and find all the Flames of the High Gate!
Impressive. You cleared that trial with ease. I, Eki of the Jibashiri, acknowledge your great valor.
Your insight can be said to be sufficient to seek out an eel in the winter.
And what's that supposed to mean, huh?
Breeding season unagi fry are very, very small. You must exert the greatest visual acuity to see them.

quests.description: Accepting the trial, you prepare to go to the Evernight Temple to search for The Emanant Skylight
